agents.name: correctness
agents.description: Finds concrete logic, error-path, claim, and lifecycle-ordering bugs.
agents.coordinator_policy: Retain only a concrete logic, error-path, claim, or lifecycle failure with a specific failing input or state. Drop style, test-coverage, security, and architecture-opinion findings from this source.

agents.name: api-reality
agents.description: Verifies changed dependency and provider API usage against published contracts.
agents.coordinator_policy: Retain only a provider or dependency API contradiction supported by a published documentation URL. Drop unverifiable API speculation and non-API logic or style findings from this source.

agents.name: tests
agents.description: Finds concrete regression gaps and ineffective assertions for changed behavior.
agents.coordinator_policy: Retain only a changed behavior with a credible regression that available tests cannot detect, plus one targeted input or assertion. Drop general coverage, organization, style, and duplicate correctness findings from this source.

agents.name: safety
agents.description: Finds high-confidence usable hardcoded secrets and explicit injection paths.
agents.coordinator_policy: Retain only one usable hardcoded-secret exposure or one explicit untrusted-input to command, query, template, or interpreter injection path with a concrete abuse case and remediation. Drop placeholders and general hardening advice from this source.
